description: DESCRIPTION: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT TO SIEMENS HEALTHCARE DIAGNOSTICS INC. via FSS contract # V797D-30175 to supply Siemens RP500 Whole Blood/Arterial Blood Gas/Critical Care Metabolites Analytical Analyzers for accurate measurement of blood gases, electrolytes, and related parameters. This will be based on a cost-per-reportable basis.
